manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top, velocity is zero, but acceleration and gravitational force remain steady. Mass changes the force, not the motion.
manifest.description: A simulation of a vertically tossed ball showing its position, velocity vector, acceleration vector, and a velocity-time graph with adjustable launch speed, gravity, and mass.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. Compare the readings at each pause near the top.
